messages:
Sam H: Heads-up: high-priority customer on Dedicated reported sudden 429s and latency spikes after a routine roll today. They were on the gold-reserved pool but requests are getting routed to shared-beta and hitting token throttles.
Anya K: Ugh. Can you paste the request headers + routing decision from the control plane logs? :eyes:
Sam H: Pasting sanitized snippet. Note the custom routing header we use: X-Client-Tiers
```
Request: POST /v1/generate
X-Client-Tiers: \"[\"gold\", \"default\"]\"
Tenant: acme-inc
---- control-plane.log ----
route_eval: tenant=acme-inc header=X-Client-Tiers value=\"[\"gold\", \"default\"]\"
selector_lookup: key=tier_map got_type=string
pool_selected=shared-beta (fallback)
```
Anya K: Wait that header looks like a JSON string inside a string. Is the client SDK double-encoding tiers? We expect either a CSV or a JSON array raw.
Kevin L: Checking gateway releases — we shipped a change that normalizes arrays to strings for tracing metadata last week. Could be related.
Maria P: Customer says they didn't change anything client-side. It started after our control-plane canary at 10:07 UTC.
routing-bot: alert: route_mismatch_rate increased for cluster eu-west-1 between 10:05-10:20 UTC (spike +7x). Auto-escalation created.
Sam H: Repro steps I ran locally:
1) curl -H \"X-Client-Tiers: \\\"[\\\"gold\\\", \\\"default\\\"]\\\"\" ... -> routed to shared
2) curl -H \"X-Client-Tiers: [\\\"gold\\\",\\\"default\\\"]\" ... -> routed correctly to gold-reserved
So parser treats the quoted JSON array as a single string key, which doesn't match the tier_map lookup and falls back.
Anya K: That explains the sudden misrouting + throttles on dedicated pools. Can we patch quick: coerce string that parses as JSON into an array before lookup?
Kevin L: I can open a tiny hotfix on control-plane: if header value is a string and startswith '[' then try json.loads(value) and normalize. Rolling to canary now.
Sam H: Thanks. Can we also add a telemetry metric to count 'stringified-array' inputs so we can alert if clients keep sending this form?
Kevin L: Yep, adding metric routing.header_type_coercions.increment(\"stringified_array\").
deploy-bot: canary-deploy initiated: control-plane v3.14.2-hotfix at 11:02 UTC -> 10% traffic
Maria P: Customer support rep notified acme-inc that we're investigating and gave a temporary mitigation: set X-Client-Tiers as CSV (gold,default) until fix applied.
Kevin L: Canary looks green for 15m, rolling to 50% now.
routing-bot: note: route_mismatch_rate decreasing back to baseline.
Sam H: Customer confirmed errors dropped and gold-reserved requests resumed. Closing escalation after prod rollout.
Anya K: Follow-up: add a note in the SDK changelog and a short KB for customers about accepted header formats to avoid future breakages.
Kevin L: Filed RFC to standardize header format and add robustness in parser (GH #4829).
